messages:
nina_sales: Customer in POC (acct=acct_Z9Y8X7) reports their free credits went from 30k -> 0 overnight and they saw a flood of 429s. they're pretty upset. can we swarm? :grimacing:
omar_support: on it. ask for a quick screenshot of the billing page + a snippet of client logs. also what SDK are they using?
li_engineer: curious if this is retries or a bad background worker replaying requests. pls capture time window.
nina_sales: sent their billing screenshot and this log excerpt:
```
2026-03-18T02:14:03Z WARN request timeout, retrying
2026-03-18T02:14:04Z INFO request sent model=redwood-medium tokens=2300
2026-03-18T02:14:05Z ERROR http status=429 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-18T02:14:10Z INFO request sent model=redwood-medium tokens=2300
2026-03-18T02:14:12Z INFO request succeeded req_id=req_aa11 tokens=2300
```
joanna_finance: I see the account used 30,120 credits between 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z and 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z. their free_credit balance was 30,000 at 01:00. metering_bot, any anomalies flagged?
metering_bot: anomaly alert: high variance in max tokens per request for acct_Z9Y8X7 between 2026-03-18T02:00Z-02:20Z. potential duplicate-request pattern detected. consolidated usage: 30,120 units.
omar_support: that pattern looks like a worker retried after timeout then the original succeeded => duplicate consumption. but the log shows 2300 tokens which normally would be capped or prorated? li, do we have any rounding or aggregation rules that could inflate unit counts?
li_engineer: tokens are billed per-request at our pricing unit (1 token = 1 unit). no rounding-up. however we recently pushed a change to the internal batcher where long-context calls are split into segments for internal buffering; if a client retries while a split stream is still processing, both attempts can consume. also there's a known SDK bug v1.3.9 where the retry loop doesn't set idempotency header. ask customer for SDK version.
nina_sales: customer says SDK=python v1.3.9 and they're using a background job that wakes every 30s to replay failed tasks. ugh.
joanna_finance: because they're replaying the job, that explains all consumption. we can offer a one-time goodwill credit; need eng confirmation on exact duplicate volume.
li_engineer: pulling logs for acct_Z9Y8X7 around 2026-03-18T02:10Z... found duplicated req_ids: req_aa10 (408), req_aa11 (200) where both consumed 2300 tokens each. counted ~13 such duplicates in the window -> ~29,900 tokens duplicate.
omar_support: recommend temporary actions: 1) advise customer to pause background replayer, 2) upgrade SDK to v1.4.0 which sets X-Idempotency-Key automatically, 3) we'll grant limited concurrency bump while they fix infra.
infra_bot: change request accepted: increase concurrency for acct_Z9Y8X7 from 6 -> 12 for 12h. ticket infra_change_20260318_09.
joanna_finance: propose credit of 29,900 units back to free_credit and reset their soft alert to lower threshold so they catch this earlier. filing approval request.
li_engineer: also created a quick checklist for customers: - use idempotency key header - avoid blind retries for 409/428/429 - check request status endpoint instead of replaying jobs - throttle background job concurrency
nina_sales: I'll send the customer the upgrade + pause instructions and the credit offer. will mention the SDK bug link and our KB.
omar_support: please include the example header: 
```
X-Idempotency-Key: 7b9f5c2d-...
```
plus sample curl to inspect request status:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests/req_aa11
```
joanna_finance: billing_bot queued credit: acct=acct_Z9Y8X7 amount=29900 reason="duplicate consumption due to background job replay and missing idempotency" status=pending approval.
metering_bot: scheduled internal postmortem: metering-team -> 2026-03-19T15:00Z to review batcher splitting behavior and edge-case dedup.
li_engineer: long-term: we'll add server-side dedup window when idempotency is absent but request fingerprints match within 5s to prevent accidental double billing for common POC patterns. raising RFC.
nina_sales: customer replied: "Thanks — pausing replayer now, upgrading SDK, really appreciate the credit offer and quick help." :pray: closing for now unless billing approval stalls.
joanna_finance: I'll route approval and note the cause in the billing audit entry.
omar_support: can someone add a short KB snippet to onboarding about background job best practices? saves future churn.
li_engineer: adding to devex backlog today.
infra_bot: ticket infra_change_20260318_09 will auto-revert at 2026-03-18T15:30Z unless extended.
joanna_finance: thanks everyone. marking thread resolved once credit approved.
